lines.zh: 我压过林地，脚边花枝低下去。
lines.en: I cross the woodland and the flowers bow by my feet.
The wood grain on my body shifts.
My arms are like two branches.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，花落了一地。
lines.en: Blossoms fall where I pass.
I know this flower forest.
I stop beside a birch.

lines.zh: 风把我的影子推得很长。
lines.en: The wind stretches my shadow.
I glance at the ground.
My feet snap the dead branches.

lines.zh: 我每一步都踩稳，怕压坏花。
lines.en: I plant every step carefully so as not to crush the flowers.

lines.zh: 我的身体高得碰到树冠。
lines.en: I'm tall enough to touch the canopy.
I go around a patch of wildflowers.
I stand like a tree.
Vines coil on my shoulders.
I don't move much.
The air here is quiet.

lines.zh: 慢慢抬起一根手指，指着你。
lines.en: Slowly raising one finger, pointing at you.

lines.zh: 鸟在我肩上理羽，我一动不动。
lines.en: A bird preens on my shoulder; I stay perfectly still.
I didn't disturb it.
It stayed a while, then flew.
I'm still standing where I was.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸像风穿过叶子。
lines.en: My breath is wind through leaves.
I'm listening to the forest.
I can hear the whole grove.
One tree is swaying.
This wood has no need for haste.
You walked out of the trees.

lines.zh: 你踩断枯枝，我在林子里听见了。
lines.en: You snapped a dead twig; I heard it in the woods.
This is my woodland.

lines.zh: 树精的我，看见你手里有东西。
lines.en: A tree spirit sees what you carry.
I don't mind.
You're standing far off.

lines.zh: 你站在花丛外，这样很好。
lines.en: You stand outside the flowers — that is good.
My arms are long. Be careful.

lines.zh: 你看起来不像是来砍树的。
lines.en: You don't look like a woodcutter.
If you are, go back.
A cherry-tree beast with thick bark.
I've watched these trees grow.
I remember this soil.

lines.zh: 你踩的那块土是新长的。
lines.en: The patch you stepped on is new.

lines.zh: 我这一身樱枝，走起来落花瓣。
lines.en: I am all cherry boughs; petals fall as I walk.

lines.zh: 你抬起手，我就看见你的脸。
lines.en: When you raise a hand, I see your face.
Your edge bit into my bark.
Sawdust fell.
The wound will grow back.
My bark split.
I shook off a layer of blossoms.
More blossoms fell.
That cut went deep.
I'm not angry.

lines.zh: 我慢慢站直，花落了一地。
lines.en: I straighten slowly, blossoms falling all around.
That's kept in my rings.
Are those plants in your hand?
I eat those.
Set it on the ground; I lower my head to eat.
I won't snatch.
That's not enough.
I accept the gesture.

lines.zh: 我弯腰时，整片花瓣落下来。
lines.en: As I bend, a whole sheet of petals falls.

lines.zh: 你退开些，我弯腰会碰落花。
lines.en: Step back; my bending will knock flowers loose.

lines.zh: 我的头低下来会吓到你。
lines.en: My head coming down may startle you.
You really needn't be afraid.

lines.zh: 我弯腰的时候，花落得更多。
lines.en: More blossoms fall when I bend.
Your scent is very faint.
You hit my leg in the flower forest.
My roots didn't shift at all.
My body is like a trunk.
Don't lean on me.

lines.zh: 你从我手臂下面钻过去。
lines.en: You ducked under my arm.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，树叶落了。
lines.en: We collided and leaves fell.
That tree swayed too.
You stepped back into the flowers.
There's a new mark on my bark.
It doesn't matter.
I'm the only one in this woodland.
I haven't thought about that.
I spend most of my time standing.
Stay off my roots.
My branches will coil around.
I want to be alone.
The wind keeps blowing.
Go back the way you came.
I need to watch these trees.
That's what I do.
I lift it between two fingers.

lines.zh: 它在我的手掌里像一颗种子。
lines.en: It sits in my palm like a single seed.

lines.zh: 这东西是从你那儿掉的？
lines.en: Did this fall from you?
I set it by the roots.
This soil will take it.
What will grow from it?
I don't know.
I looked at it.
It isn't a seed.
I put it in a hollow.
You've raised your axe.
In my woodland.
I saw that clearly.

lines.zh: 我的手臂抬起来，枝条跟着张开。
lines.en: I raise my arm and the branches spread with it.
This isn't what I want to do.
But you raised it.

lines.zh: 樱桃木的树干，就是我身子。
lines.en: The cherry trunk is my body.
Flowers are crushed underfoot.

lines.zh: 我身上开满花，走路掉瓣。
lines.en: Blossoms grow on me and fall as I walk.
I still have to come.
The branches all move your way.

lines.zh: 你举起它的那一下我记住了。
lines.en: I remember the moment you raised it.
I follow at your side.
You hide on the other side of a tree.
Cherries hang on me.
It won't help you.
My branches reach over.
You're behind the tree.
My branches can reach.
My arm goes around the trunk.
You backed off.

lines.zh: 我脚下多走一步，花落一地。
lines.en: One more step and flowers fall all around me.
All of this is my woodland.
You're standing on my roots.
My branch lashes down.
You blocked it.
A branch snapped off.
I reach again.
This time I caught your hand.
The branches draw in bit by bit.
You broke free.
There are scratches on the back of my hand.
I drew back one branch.
I don't want to fight again.
Step farther off and I'll stop.

lines.zh: 我的手指抖着，枝条却收紧了。
lines.en: My fingers tremble, but the branches tighten.

lines.zh: 我从花林间立起来，满身樱枝。
lines.en: I rise among the flowering trees, covered in cherry branches.
Turns out I always looked like a tree.
Blossoms fall on my shoulders.
This wood welcomes me.

lines.zh: 我一步一步走进光里，樱桃枝在头顶。
lines.en: I step into the light, cherry branches overhead.
The trees lean my way.

lines.zh: 我的手按在树干上，树皮还是温的。
lines.en: I lay my hand on the trunk; the bark is still warm.
They're all well.
I looked into the distance.
I'm alone in the flower forest.
The wind sounds lovely.
I'll stay.
Fire touched wood and I panicked.

lines.zh: 我一倒下，压塌了一片花。
lines.en: When I fell, I crushed a patch of flowers.

lines.zh: 水浸到木头里，变得很沉。
lines.en: Water soaked into the wood and made it heavy.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的枝条撕掉一半。
lines.en: The blast tore half my branches away.

lines.zh: 箭扎进肩头的樱枝，花落了几瓣。
lines.en: The arrow sticks into the cherry branch on my shoulder; petals fall.
A flash seared across my bark.

lines.zh: 根吸不到水，我慢慢干了。
lines.en: My roots can't draw water. I'm drying out.

lines.zh: 雷劈在林子里，我浑身一颤。
lines.en: Lightning struck the grove and shuddered through me.

lines.zh: 没有土，我的根在空里抓着。
lines.en: With no soil, my roots clutch at nothing.
